title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E07 — Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast
Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E08 — The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs
Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E06 — Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E10 — South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E04 — The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E04 — Carne Asada with La Familia
Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E02 — Hermosillo Food Crawl
Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E08 — The Heart of Tequila
Pati visits the birthplace of Mexico's most famous spirit, the town of Tequila. Back home Pati makes a brunch of corn tortilla egg nests with salsa verde con chile de árbol and traditional arroz rojo.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E10 — Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E05 — Flour Power
Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E09 — Double Vallarta
Pati is in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations - Puerto Vallarta. She gets an insider's tour of the best street food from one of the town's most acclaimed chefs, Thierry Boulet.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices
Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats
Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S11 E04 — Bread Masters
Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S10 E03 — Jalisco Classics
In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

title: Pati's Mexican Table
description:
S09 E01 — Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E02 — Bring Your Own Lunch
These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E08 — The Future is Flavor
Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E04 — How Do You Like Them Apples
Apples aren't just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There's a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they're in season.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E09 — Pantry Pasta
It's no secret that pasta is Frankie's favorite; he's serving it up all night without even opening his fridge.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E03 — Salad Salad Salad
Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball
No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E07 — Piece Of The Pie
There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E01 — Citrus Sunshine
Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E02 — Suppertime Superstar
From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E10 — Cry Me An Allium River
Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E06 — I Need To Eat Right Now
At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S06 E05 — Fancy Pants Pasta
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E06 — Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup
Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E03 — Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse
Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E01 — Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon
From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E06 — Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup
Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E04 — Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties
With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E02 — Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E05 — Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart
Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

description:

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E01 — Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E02 — Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E03 — Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E08 — An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto
Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E07 — Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E02 — Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E05 — Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake
Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E06 — Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart
Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E08 — Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E09 — Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E03 — Chicken Pizza
Ditch the dough. Chef Frankie Celenza makes a protein-packed pizza the whole family will love. This is chicken pizza like you've never tried at home - until now.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E13 — Whole Chicken Paprikash
Chef Frankie Celenza stretches one whole chicken and a pack of ramen to make a rich and warm Chicken Paprikash dish, swapping egg noodles for buttered ramen and using the seasoning packet to boost the sauce.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E12 — Fancy Fish Filet Sandwich
Chef Frankie Celenza levels up a drive-thru classic fish filet sandwich with ultra-crispy fried cod, homemade tartar sauce and pimento cheese. Plus, five reasons not to toss your leftover pickle brine.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E10 — Pub-Style Pie
A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E09 — Ramen Croutons and Napa Cabbage
Chef Frankie Celenza elevates a packet of ramen for a hearty yet dainty salad. The dish features crispy croutons atop a crunchy napa cabbage with fruit, nuts and leftover chicken. Plus, a reminder to make your own salad dressing. You can do it!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E06 — Meatloaf More Than Once
Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E01 — BEC for One, For Many
Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E16 — Half Homemade Matzo Ball Soup
Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E17 — A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita
Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab
Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

description:

Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E06 — Vegetables, but Delicious
Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E02 — Yakitori and More-Y
Don't sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it's Chef Dale night to cook! He's serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E07 — Street Eats off the Grill
Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E01 — Ribs Remix
Ribs are a lifestyle, and Chef Dale's living it up with smoky beef shorties in tangy red wine glaze, Miami-style pork ribs dripping in bacon-guava BBQ, spicy baked beans, and killer key lime caramel cones. Grab some napkins!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza
Chef Dale Talde grills a Chicago-style pie, pepperoni pizza pocket, chicken wings, and a zesty grilled Caesar.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E07 — Pizza-Town
Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S04 E01 — The Art of Open Fire Cooking
Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s'more dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E14 — Family-Friendly BBQ
Chef Dale Talde creates a tasty menu that kids & parents alike will love! Apple pancakes with coconut brown butter syrup, grilled cheese & tomato soup, cheesy chicken parm, and a sticky s'mores dessert round out the full day of deliciousness.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E02 — It's Taco Time
Tacos are the way to Chef Dale's heart, and he's grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E05 — Kabob-alicious
Dale skewers ribeye, salmon, smoky eggplant dip, and grilled peaches. Food on sticks never tasted better!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S05 E03 — The Heat Is On
Dale's turning up the heat! Carolina Reaper wings hotter than your ex, sweet-chili NY strip steak, smoky grilled chipotle Texas toast, and ancho-gochujang pineapple skillet cake for dessert. Bring some water!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways
Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E03 — Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
Chef Dale grills to impress with restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S02 E08 — Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it's Sunday somewhere, right?

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S03 E01 — Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

title: All Up In My Grill
description:
S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill
Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.
